summary: sankey link value is 0 or negative
help: Give the link a positive value.
rationale: A link with no positive weight carries no flow, so the diagram drops or distorts it.

summary: the same sankey source and target pair is declared twice
help: Merge the two links into one, or point them at different nodes.
rationale: Repeated links stack their ribbons, so the total flow reads larger than the data says.

summary: sankey link source and target are the same node
help: Point the link at a different node.
rationale: A link from a node to itself is usually a copy-paste mistake and renders as a flow that returns where it started.
